reason: Neighbourhood leakage detection via satellite time series is established, not open: Jayachandran et al. 2017 (Science) detected deforestation spillover onto non-enrolled land near a PES program; Moffette & Gibbs 2021 studies agri-displacement leakage in the Amazon. Neither is EU or regenerative-ag; no checked MRV vendor (Agreena, Perennial, Kermap/xFarm/eAgronom) advertises spillover detection. Delta must be the Sentinel-1/2 practice-signal technique, not EU location alone.

prior_art.title: Cash for carbon: A randomized trial of payments for ecosystem services to reduce deforestation
prior_art.why: Uses satellite imagery to measure deforestation on enrolled vs. neighbouring parcels in a Ugandan PES program, testing leakage to nearby land. Same core method (time series, treated vs. adjacent untreated land) but forest domain, binary output, no EU deployment.

prior_art.title: Agricultural Displacement and Deforestation Leakage in the Brazilian Legal Amazon
prior_art.why: Studies deforestation leakage caused by agricultural displacement in the Amazon; full text was paywalled (confirmed via Crossref metadata only, not fetched), so exact remote-sensing method is unverified firsthand. Different domain (Amazon soy/cattle vs EU cover-crop/tillage) and no EU deployment.

type_b_fields.measurable_axis: Detection latency/granularity: sub-monthly Sentinel-1/2 practice-trace change vs. Jayachandran's annual binary deforestation classification from high-res imagery.
type_b_fields.attributable_to: Fusing Sentinel-1 SAR with Sentinel-2 optical time series to read tillage/cover-crop practice signals, not just binary land-cover/forest-loss change.

nearest_neighbours_do_not: Kermap, xFarm, eAgronom CoverCrop, Agreena and Perennial monitor practice adoption or land-use change inside enrolled/registered parcels. None of them compare enrolled fields against neighbouring non-enrolled fields to flag displaced intensification.
